lines.speaker: clerk_of_the_house
lines.text: Two signatures, then. Sponsor and witness. Print underneath. You will want to use a name you do not mind keeping.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You write it. It is the first entry in a register that will still be open in 2312, and it is in your handwriting.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Provenance is the record of who owned a thing and when. I have just put myself in the chain of the instrument I was auditing.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: That was not a small thing to do and you did it very quickly.
